profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Working as a Software Engineer with over ten years of experience in all development stages from design to end user support. Problem solver backed by professional experience developing solutions in C++, Python and Kotlin coupled with a strong quantitative background.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the Facebook marketplace team. Working with distributed systems, developing solutions in C++ and Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Mathematics

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Working as a software engineer in the telecommunications industry (https://www.netscout.com/product/truecall). Main activities include: review and implementation of new features where the main driving factors are; performance and maintainability (Python, C++, Kotlin). Unit and Integration test implementations. Implementing restful endpoints in Kotlin. Writing documentation in the form of design documents, knowledge transfer articles and knowledge base articles. Perform quantitative analysis on software metrics to validate application results and performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Kotlin · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Mathematics · Docker Products

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Performed research in the area of strongly correlated materials via numerical techniques. Implemented resource intensive numerical calculations using a combination of C, Fortran and Python. Performed Quantitative analysis of the results, and communicate such results with peers in written and presentation form.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Research in the area of condensed matter physics in the nanoscale division. Performed computational calculations to determine the electronic structure of a given nanostructure. These calculations would allow the research team a better understanding of the magnetic properties of atoms deposited in surfaces.

publications.title: Spin and exchange coupling for Ti embedded in a surface dipolar network
